subject: Creative Arts
source: NaCCA Creative Arts Curriculum for Primary Schools, Basic 4–6 (September 2019)
accessibility: Prompts may be read aloud. Learners may answer orally, in writing, by drawing, movement, or demonstration as appropriate. Use teacher-provided local examples. Assess curriculum knowledge and skills, not personal identity or access to materials.
